title: {Syn} Goldbach Is Easy to State and Hard to Close
content:
Goldbach strong conjecture says every even integer greater than 2 is the sum of two primes. Computers have checked enormous ranges, but a proof for all even numbers is still unknown.

The statement is a good example of number theory drama: elementary enough for a school notebook, yet resistant to the best available methods.

Why it matters: number theory keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
